clinicalSources.title: AAP HealthyChildren — Encopresis and faecal soiling

caption: An abstract bypass model explains how liquid stool can leak around retained hard stool and cause overflow soiling.
question: How can constipation cause faecal soiling?
answer: Softer stool can leak around an impacted mass, often without the child noticing.
